deterministic_ties: existing seeded SHA256 identity policy; seed 0
precision_denominator: requested k, even when the judged pool is shorter
recall_denominator: all relevant POIs within the explicitly named judged pool only
eligibility: all catalogue rows without explicit exclude_reason; no invented timing/budget constraints
fit_corpus: all eligible current catalogue documents; never queries, labels or judged-only subset
quality_scope: historical label transfer in complete small judged pools, not full-catalogue quality
strict_evidence_scope: require identical cleaned scoring fields and at least two judged candidates
